comments.quote: 藏在莫干山竹林裏的寶藏小院，完全是想象中山居生活的樣子。車子沿着小路開進來，兩旁都是翠竹，推開院門瞬間就安靜下來了。房間收拾得乾淨清爽，窗户對着山景，早上被鳥鳴叫醒，推開窗就是滿目的綠，連空氣裏都帶着竹子的清香。 老闆夫妻倆特別實在，三餐都是地道的農家菜，筍乾燉雞鮮得連喝兩碗，自家種的青菜清甜爽口，完全是城裡吃不到的味道。閑暇時在院子裏喝茶發呆，或者和朋友打牌唱K，日子慢得剛剛好。性價比很高， 週末來放空兩天再合適不過，下次來莫干山還會選這裏。
comments.author: Guest User
comments.quoteEn: A hidden gem of a courtyard in the Moganshan bamboo, exactly the mountain life you picture. You drive in along a lane with green bamboo either side, push the gate open and everything goes quiet. The room was clean and fresh with the hills in the window, birdsong woke us, and opening it there was green everywhere and bamboo in the air. The couple who run it are thoroughly decent, and all three meals are proper country cooking. The dried shoot and chicken soup was so good I had two bowls, and their own greens were sweet and crisp in a way you cannot get in a city. Tea and idleness in the courtyard, or cards and karaoke with friends, the pace just right. Very good value, and a perfect two days to empty your head. I would pick it again.
